title: Frozen learned-policy frontier audit
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: Ranking every mature frozen 20k-hand Slumbot result together with checkpoint availability and provenance will identify a reproducible preservation parent and prevent historical summary-only candidates from being treated as viable initializations.
material_change: Run a read-only audit over completed experiment records, extract 20k-hand bb/100 and confidence intervals, verify checkpoint existence and hashes, and emit a ranked JSON/Markdown evidence matrix.
baseline: Historical Standard10 greedy -11.4275 bb/100; current audited bridge -24.5683; historical single imitation teacher -18.5025 but negative and summary-only.
notes: No policy queries, environment hands, Slumbot hands, checkpoint selection, or training. Historical imitation remains a negative control.

Two zero-hand audit attempts failed before artifact emission: first the imported Standard10 title lacked the word Slumbot; second the current bridge ID lacked it. Filtering was narrowed to explicit external-evidence IDs plus legacy whitelist; no policy queries or evidence mutations occurred.

result.summary: Read-only audit ranked 14 frozen external results with at least 20,000 hands. No point estimate was positive and no 95% CI lower bound was positive. Historical Standard10 greedy remains best at -11.4275 and is the only reproducible frontier parent; the -18.5025 imitation result is negative, imported-summary-only, and lacks a surviving checkpoint in its record.
result.conclusion: Standard10 is the only defensible preservation parent. The current bridge independently confirms the same checkpoint is negative at -24.5683, so it is an initialization/reference rather than a champion. Single-teacher imitation remains a negative control and must not be revived as new evidence.
result.next_step: Test a qualitatively different state-conditioned counterfactual policy-improvement mechanism initialized from and explicitly residualized around frozen Standard10; require exact-v6 mechanism and untouched multi-anchor evidence before any Slumbot spend.
